title: La Scala Chopped Salad
intro: One of my favorite salads from my childhood growing up in Beverly Hills, from the world renowned La Scala Boutique.
ingredients: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ lb ((4 ounces) Italian salami thinly sliced
steps: In a small bowl, add all of the salad dressing ingredients. Whisk everything together (or you can place the ingredients in a lidded jar and shake them to combine).
To a large bowl, add the shredded lettuce, chickpeas, Italian salami, and mozzarella cheese. Pour the prepared dressing on top and toss to coat.
